scripts.preflight: npm run preflight:go && npm run preflight:build && npm run preflight:secrets
scripts.preflight:go: go vet ./... && go test -timeout 180s ./... && go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@v2.28.0 -conf .gosec.json -quiet -exclude-dir=ui/node_modules -exclude=G104,G115,G404,G702,G703,G704,G112,G114,G118,G120,G124,G204,G301,G304,G306,G705,G710 ./...
scripts.preflight:secrets: gitleaks detect --source . --no-banner 2>&1 && echo 'secrets: OK' || echo 'gitleaks: SKIP (not installed)'
